mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE operation = #{operation} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM audit_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audit_logs WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') AND created_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, session_id, operation, operation_params, status, confirm_token, client_ip, trace_id, created_at, completed_at, result_message) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{operation}, #{operationParams}, #{status}, #{confirmToken}, #{clientIp}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt}, #{completedAt}, #{resultMessage})
